fenrir.raw:
Description: This Icy Werewolf was chained due to her vicious powers. She hates the collar because it makes her look like a dog.

Login: You're here to free me!?
Well, hurry up, already!

Meet: Hmph! I'm not your lap dog!
I answer to no one!

Friendship: I'd tear you to bits if it
weren't for this collar!

FriendshipMax: I'd help you if you'd just
take this collar off.

FriendshipEvent: I hate how dogs serve
humans.
 
But you're not half bad, so
I'd be willing to serve you.

BattleStart: Grrr... Feel my fangs!

BattleEnd: Stupid collar...

Rebirth: Tsk, I broke out of the chains,
but I can't break this collar!
 
Insolent fool! Know that I shall
never give up!
 
I'll grow stronger, rip off this
collar, and maul you to death!

aisha.raw:
Description: This merchant sells many strange wares and items of unknown origin. Buyer beware!

Login: 

Meet: Welcome, Milord! I have many
unusual wares again today.

Friendship: Do I have a magic lamp?
Why, of course I do!

FriendshipMax: I bear no responsibility for my
wares once they're yours!

FriendshipEvent: Thanks for your business.
You're my best customer!
 
I'll come again soon, Milord.
Just you wait

BattleStart: Check out my wares!

BattleEnd: I can't sell this stuff now!

Rebirth: Where do I source my wares?
Hee hee, that's a secret.
 
You may wonder about that,
but don't worry. Just buy!
 
I risk my life to get this stuff,
so don't let it go to waste!

mage-emilie.raw:
Description: Emilie has found being a mage rather tedious, but she still wants to be an archmage.

Login: 

Meet: Time to do some real work.
I'm a full-fledged mage now!

Friendship: Find lost cats and babysit?! Is
that all mages ever do?!

FriendshipMax: If I pull off this job, I just might
qualify to be an archmage!

FriendshipEvent: Bring on those jobs, whatever
they may be!
 
So, what's next? Huh?! An
S-class job?! B-But...

BattleStart: I'll be an archmage soon!

BattleEnd: I-I'll probably get fired now.

seir.raw:
Description: This demon is also a knight with a white steed. She loves riding out to greet people.

Login: 

Meet: I've come to greet you, Milord!
I'm so glad you asked!

Friendship: Where to now? My trusty
steed will take us anywhere!

FriendshipMax: After I take you where you
want, let's hang out!

FriendshipEvent: I'm so glad you put your trust
in me! I'll take you anywhere!
 
But first, do you mind if we
have a little chat?

BattleStart: Speedy curbside service!

BattleEnd: Oops, I think I'm lost.

Rebirth: Umm... Must you be in such
a rush?
 
I've been waiting oh so long
to greet you.
 
Can we be alone, just the
two of us, if only for this day?

madeline.raw:
Description: This wandering white  mage travels around  and heals people all  over the world.

Login: 

Meet: I'm not suspicious. I'm just 
a white mage passing by.

Friendship: Hey, stay still.
I'm healing you now.

FriendshipMax: If you get hurt in a fight
I'll heal you right away.

FriendshipEvent: I want to travel around the 
world, meet different people.
 
On my way back, I'll make 
sure to stop by this kingdom.

BattleStart: All of you, don't get hurt.

BattleEnd: I still need to help the others...

Rebirth: You want me to stay here in 
your kingdom? Sorry, I can't.
 
I want to heal the injuries and
illnesses of all the people. 
 
But I think I can spend time
with you while I'm still here.

like these puppets!

Hee hee, you're funny!
 
But I can make your dream
come true with my puppets.

BattleEnd: Don't destroy this love.
